name: transit-story
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: educational popup background illustration for a Korean elementary exploration canvas game.
Create a polished landscape 3:2 illustration, ideally 1536x1024. Generic fictional public facility that explains its community role, NOT a depiction of any named real-world venue. Japanese JRPG storybook painterly aesthetic: gentle hand-painted shading, warm clean outlines, softly rounded welcoming architecture, green foliage, cream highlights, wood brown accents, vivid but harmonious colors, lovely readable miniature environment details. Elevated three-quarter view with convincing perspective. Fill the frame with an inviting calm daytime scene, keeping the essential role-defining objects large and easy to recognize. No people required. NO readable text, lettering, numbers, logos, brand marks, watermarks, captions, borders, UI, or labels. This is a single coherent landscape scene, not a grid or sprite sheet. No magenta/chroma background.
Subject: a Korean small-town railway station and nearby bus terminal as a connected civic transport hub. Show a clearly recognizable cream-and-green passenger TRAIN at a low railway platform on one side, and a clearly recognizable blue-green public BUS parked beside a sheltered bus terminal on the other side. Both the train and bus must be prominent and unmistakable, each with several windows and distinct vehicle geometry. Include a modest cream station building, simple platform canopy, covered bus waiting shelter, paved footpaths safely separated from rails and bus driveway, benches, tactile paving, low landscaping, a few trees and distant gentle green hills. Generic modern provincial Korean town architecture, no named landmarks. Cheerful afternoon light, no traffic chaos. No people necessary.
